title: Customize your profile
heading: Customize your profile {sparkle}
intro: Everyone who visits {profile} sees it just like the preview. Your username comes from GitHub, and so does your picture until you upload one.
look.title: Look
look.description: Pick the theme and banner visitors see your profile in, whatever theme they wear themselves.
look.browsing: You browse the site in {theme}. {change} or make your own.
about.title: About you
about.description: Status, favorite waifu and bio understand Markdown: {bold}, {italic}, {code} and {links}. The bio also takes lists, quotes and code blocks.
about.statusPlaceholder: Shipping a tiny compiler, send snacks
skills.title: Skills and links
skills.description: Up to {count} skills, your website, and a few more links.
repos.title: Featured repos
repos.description: Show off up to {count} of your public GitHub repos. They show as cards on your profile, in the order you put them, and their stars and descriptions stay in sync with GitHub.
bugs.title: Bug reports
bugs.description: For this browser, and it takes effect at once: not part of your profile, so there's nothing to save.
preview.label: Live preview
pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: Click or drop a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF (up to {size} MB). GIFs stay animated. These save right away.
pictures.avatarCustom: Your own picture, cropped to a square.
pictures.bannerCustom: Your banner decoration plays on top. Pick Picture only below to show just the picture.
pictures.bannerDefault: Cropped to {width}×{height}. Your banner decoration keeps playing on top of it.
reports.sent1: Kinds of errors, and which page they happened on
reports.sent2: How long pages took to load and change, and slow frames
reports.sent3: Which pages get visited, counted together
reports.sent4: Your browser family and OS family
reports.never2: Your name, account or the address of the page
reports.never3: Your IP address, or anything that tells you apart
reports.switchNote: Counts only, so we can find what breaks or drags. They go to this site's own server and on to our analytics; this browser talks to nothing else.
